items.text: Verify that a preflight check on a clean workspace with no local modifications allows proceeding with the checkout operation.
items.expected: The operation proceeds without any warnings or blocks because the workspace is clean, ensuring no local changes are lost.

items.text: Verify that a preflight check on a dirty workspace containing uncommitted changes blocks the checkout operation.
items.expected: The operation is blocked and an explicit warning is displayed indicating presence of uncommitted changes to prevent accidental data loss.

items.text: Verify that a preflight check on a stale checkout workspace that is behind the remote branch warns the user but allows override.
items.expected: The system warns about stale local state with an option to fetch/update before checkout; blocking depends on configuration but default behavior is warning without blocking.
